subject: prd/implement-now
statement: a worker turns a positive task charter into a genuinely-green proposal under the resolved native profile and reaches only the designated bounded terminal for an adversarial/failure case
intent: versioned positive and adversarial task corpus through the real runtime per harness; at least five decode-pinned positive runs per supported harness per release candidate
fit_criterion: 100% of required positive runs reach green with launch matching EVT-7; 100% of designated adversarial cases reach their expected bounded terminal; zero hollow-as-succeeded or cross-task contamination; the report records required/executed counts and per-case outcomes
